description: Save a barcode to QRdx, listed under Barcodes in the dashboard to edit and download later. Needs a QRdx API key with full access on this MCP connection (Authorization: Bearer qrdx_…); it saves to the key's workspace. Every plan saves barcodes (1,000 on Free). Takes the format and value generate_barcode takes, an optional title and options (foreground and background as hex, showText, barHeightMm, quietZone, scale, rotation).

folderId.description: A folder of the workspace by id (the codes' folders); null for none

format.description: The symbology: ean13, ean8, upca, upce, code128, code39, itf14, gs1-128, datamatrix, pdf417, aztec (EAN-13 and UPC-A for retail products, ITF-14 for cartons, GS1-128 for logistics labels, Code 128 for your own labels, Data Matrix, PDF417 and Aztec for 2D)

options.description: How it's drawn; anything left out uses the format's defaults (black on white, the minimum quiet zone, scale 4)

barHeightMm.description: Bar height of linear barcodes in millimetres at the vector size (default depends on the format)

quietZone.description: Blank margin in modules: left and right of linear barcodes (up to 20), all round 2D codes (up to 10). Defaults to the format's minimum.

scale.description: Pixels per module in raster images (1-10, default 4)

showText.description: Print the digits or text under linear barcodes (default true; 2D codes have none)

title.description: A name to find it by, up to 100 characters (default: none; lists show the value)

value.description: The number or text to encode, checked against the format's rules. Retail numbers can leave the check digit off and it's added.

name: save_barcode
title: Save a barcode
